correctness.rationale: For any finite abelian dual H and graph with only K2/K3 blocks, the block-cut tree is rooted and local character orthogonality gives s(alpha) and s(alpha)s(beta)-s(alpha beta). Exhaustive q^2 local level classification shows no zero at q>=3. The balanced-to-nonroot-subtree-character map is explicitly triangular and bijective, yielding exactly q^(N-1) nonzero multipliers and independent local factors. Extremes are simultaneously attainable. Two standalone exact full-transform checks (cyclic orders 3/4/5 and Klein four) reproduce values and multiplicities on nonisomorphic examples. No infinite assertion relies on enumeration.

value.rationale: Exact full Fourier information recovery, sharp inverse stability and the entire integer multiplier multiset for every triangular cactus with an arbitrary finite abelian q-colour palette are natural, structural invariants. The surprising block-shape universality unifies distinct glued-triangle and bridge geometries and distinguishes full all-degree reconstruction from known first-harmonic singularity. This is not merely the standard chromatic polynomial, since that gives only the trivial multiplier; the stated nonzero spectrum, sharp norm, and independence for all shapes require a separate character argument.
